why_this_file_exists: The certified figures are asserted from two places that must not share a definition.
`backend/tests/certified.py` holds them as literals so a rule-pack edit cannot move
the gate along with the engine. This file is the PRODUCTION-readable copy, needed
because the runtime equivalence gate refuses to serve a lakehouse-sourced run that
does not reproduce them - and production code may not import from tests/.
Two copies would normally be a defect. `tests/test_certified_figures_contract.py`
asserts they agree, so a drift fails loudly rather than silently.
never_edit: A change that moves these is either a real improvement needing re-reconciliation with Experian, or a bug. It is never a value that needs updating to make something pass.
